answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with decaying standing: each agent starts low on a trust ridge and earns non-transferable standing only through peer-attested jobs, and standing erodes unless renewed by fresh work. High-value transactions need high standing, so a Sybil swarm pays steeply: every fake identity must do real, costly, attested work before transacting at scale, and splitting effort across thousands of identities multiplies cost, not reward. Standing is an oasis earned drop by drop; no ivory credential bought on a market carries standing, so bought accounts stay locked out.
